column1: # note: The 2025 Tax Chart, Section A (Tax Rate Chart). Missouri prints no tax table. The first row reads "$0 to $1,313" and the tax is $0; the rest read "over" and "but not over".
# note: The chart is the same for every filing status and is applied to each spouse's taxable income (lines 29Y and 29S) separately. It is repeated for every status.
# note: Section B multiplies the excess by the rate in cents, adds the base tax, and rounds to the nearest whole dollar for lines 30Y and 30S.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
